scope: Independent authorization/module/contracts critic; root coordinates full-kernel audit and final CI.

finding.name: Registry executable projection aliases caller-owned manifest memory
finding.effect: Caller mutation of guards, capabilities, dependencies, conflicts, migration metadata or raw policy bytes after construction changed AcceptsManifest, contrary to the immutable registry contract.
finding.fix: Store the canonical executable projection as an immutable string at construction; retain UseNumber canonicalization and compare against that frozen value.
finding.green: All internal/modules and internal/inventory tests pass with -race; targeted real PostgreSQL characterization passes.

coverage_map.result: Confirmed red before production edit; canonical string snapshot fixes shared slice/RawMessage aliases.

coverage_map.area: module identity, compatibility, capabilities, dependencies, conflicts and storage binding
coverage_map.result: Full existing modules race suite passed; five targeted Go mutations killed.

coverage_map.area: guard invocation failures and SQL-only authority
coverage_map.result: Existing unit/integration characterization passes; SQL remains the sole business verdict.
New real-PostgreSQL characterization passes; eight SQL mutants killed, including float64 rounding beyond exact integer precision.
All 256 finite grant masks and 128 reproducible generated cases pass; permission/organization/warehouse omission mutants killed.

coverage_map.area: module lifetime, storage metadata and retained guards
coverage_map.result: Existing real-PostgreSQL characterization passed, including checksum/missing/unexpected migration and manifest mismatch.
Real-PostgreSQL characterization passes: unauthorized/self/stale-policy approval and inherited server/database ownership privileges refused.

limits: The documented low-level SQL contract trusts the backend database role and treats p_actor as trusted server metadata (docs/postgresql-core.md:131); absence of end-user SQL authentication is not reported as a newly discovered bypass.
Caller-owned in-process module code and schema-owner-installed SQL remain trusted; this audit does not make them a sandbox.
Passing characterization is not represented as red TDD evidence.
Sixteen curated mutants are a bounded sensitivity check, not proof over every possible mutation.
HTTP/OIDC, inventory accounting/concurrency and jobs/transport are covered by separate root-assigned critics; final combined CI is the root responsibility.
